description: This circular walk explores the area around the Buckinghamshire village of Winchmore Hill. The varied walk visits a series of peaceful woodland areas including Penn Wood which lies just to the north west of the village. You'll also pass through Amersham Old Town and Coleshill before returning to Winchmore Hill. On the way there's lots of pretty bluebells to see in the woodland areas and some fine views over the surrounding countryside of the Chilterns AONB.
